description:
Cast Essence Flux by paying {U}, targeting  Scholar of the Ages
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Essence Flux, blinking Scholar of the Ages
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Essence Flux and up to one other instant or sorcery to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.
